text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista hasn't been in the best shape lately.
When she visits a shrine to pray...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hello! What a coincidence.
Are you here to visit the shrine too, Tran-san?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"As for me~, I'm doing a photoshoot with my new smartphone.
Wanted to check out its telephoto lens from up high, you see."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Since we're here, mind if I take a quick clip?
I kinda wanna test out some video with motion, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mhun. Well then, well then~...
Buena-san, what brings you here today?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an interview?
Fufu, all right then... *ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You see, today...
I wanted to have God hear what I have to say.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've hit a bit of a plateau lately.
At times like this, I make sure to properly visit a shrine to pray.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you listen to me talk... I feel like God is watching over me.
...It brings me a little peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The peace of mind that comes from knowing God is 'watching over us'...
Maybe that's what a divine blessing really is.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps that's true.
Well then, I'll go make my prayer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista quietly offered her prayer.
It was the same earnest sight she had shown since long ago.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah.
Well, truth is, I was actually recording Buena-chan praying too, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
My phone's burning hot right around there.
Must be under a sudden, heavy load.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I was curious, so I was checking the recording...
Look at this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounding the praying Buena Vista... it's showing up.
A gently glowing, aura-like light...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan said "God will watch over us,"
but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, yeah, that's what you'd think, right~?
I'm pretty sure it's just a camera glitch, though..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry to keep you waiting, both of you.
Did the footage record properly?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mm... of course, it was a complete success~
And how was your shrine visit, Buena-chan?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Well... hehe. Ever since I made my prayer,
I feel as though my body has become lighter somehow.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Right? Back on track, crisis averted, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it a problem with the new smartphone, or...
is Buena-chan really—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Hmm. Looks like the camera inspection will be continuing for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll help out too!
Right now, I feel like I could handle
any request you throw at me! Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Buena Vista regained her top form. Surely... the blessings had done their work.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Wait, is it starting to rain?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... God is mourning Buena-chan's
poor form and weeping boo-hoo tears...?!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding~ I can see rainclouds over there,
so it might start pouring down soon."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Rain, huh... I don't have an umbrella on me.
choice_data_list: Let's head back to the academy for today, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
I really wanted to... pray properly, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to pray to her heart's content, Buena Vista remained in a slump...
